name: AutomationBench
intro: AutomationBench 是 Zapier 提出的跨应用 REST API 智能体基准。它从真实自动化工作流模式出发合成并强化任务，在 47 个应用、约 500 个端点组成的确定性模拟世界中，检验智能体能否自主完成可验证的业务状态变更。基准包含 600 个公开任务和 600+ 个私有留出任务。
build_method: 真实工作流模式提炼、LLM 辅助任务合成、专家审计与确定性模拟
metric: 严格任务通过率（全有或全无）, 平均美元成本
task_type: Agent任务, 跨应用工作流, REST API工具调用
eval_feature: 跨应用, 自主API发现, 策略遵循, 确定性终态验证
scale: 600个公开任务 + 600+个私有留出任务；6个业务领域；47个应用；约500个API端点
task_type_en: Agent Task, Cross-Application Workflow, REST API Tool Use
build_method_en: Real Workflow Pattern Mining, LLM-Assisted Task Synthesis, Expert Auditing, Deterministic Simulation
eval_feature_en: Cross-Application, Autonomous API Discovery, Policy Adherence, Deterministic End-State Verification
intro_en: AutomationBench is Zapier's cross-application REST-API agent benchmark. It synthesizes and hardens tasks from real automation workflow patterns, then tests whether an agent can autonomously produce verifiable business-state changes in deterministic simulated worlds spanning 47 apps and about 500 endpoints. The benchmark contains 600 public tasks and more than 600 private held-out tasks.
scale_en: 600 public tasks + 600+ private held-out tasks; 6 business domains; 47 apps; about 500 API endpoints
metric_en: Strict all-or-nothing task pass rate, average USD cost
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.18934 and Zapier's official AutomationBench methodology: real negative-feedback workflow patterns without customer PII; six business domains; candidate-task synthesis with Opus 4.6, GPT-5.3 Codex, and Gemini 3; hardening through distractors, hidden information, near-name ambiguity, and layered policies; deterministic task contracts and repeated audits; 600 public plus 600+ private tasks; simulated worlds covering 47 apps and about 500 endpoints; BM25 top-five API-schema search plus execute calls; a 50-step autonomous limit; final-state positive and negative assertions; all-or-nothing task scoring; and pass-rate plus average-cost leaderboard reporting.
